In the middle, show how {brand} and {product} create the reversal or solve the awkward moment, ending with a hero product shot and CTA. On-screen text: "链接发我". Sound must be original internet-style beat, whooshes, record scratch, beeps, or user-supplied licensed music; no real brands, celebrities, film clips, platform watermarks, or unauthorized lines.
items.negativePrompt: blurry, watermark, distorted hands, extra fingers, text artifacts, real brand logos, celebrity likeness, low resolution, flicker

items.title: 妈见夸
items.description: 妈妈终于夸了的温暖产品梗。
items.prompt: 使用 {photo} 作为第一帧和 {product} 外观参考。竖屏中文互联网梗视频：妈妈审视产品，主角紧张展示，妈妈点头说这个还行，全场慢动作鼓掌。 镜头要有快速推拉、表情定格、弹幕式吐槽、夸张 UI 和清晰产品特写，但不要丑化真实人物。中段展示 {brand} 的 {product} 如何带来反转或解决尴尬，结尾给产品英雄镜头和行动提示。屏幕文字写「妈见夸」。声音必须是原创网络感节奏、whoosh、record scratch、提示音或用户提供的授权音乐；不使用真实品牌、明星、影视片段、平台水印或未授权台词。

items.title: 美妆限时秒杀
items.description: 美妆限时秒杀突出 {product} 的直播转化点。
items.prompt: 为 {brand} 制作直播带货竖屏切片，主推 {product}。直播间有柔光灯、产品台、弹幕贴片和倒计时，主播把 {product} 推到镜头前，用手部演示讲清质地、功能、适用人群和优惠。镜头先抓产品近景，再切主播表情、价格牌、库存数字和领取按钮。节奏像真实直播高光：第一秒喊利益点，中段给细节和效果，结尾明确说上链接、限时秒杀或领取优惠。使用 {photo} 作为第一帧和产品参考。屏幕文字写「限时秒杀，先到先得」，保留可替换价格区域。声音是原创直播节奏、普通话口播、倒计时提示音，不出现真实平台水印或品牌。
items.promptEn: Create a vertical live-commerce highlight for {brand}, selling {product}. The livestream room has soft lights, product table, comment stickers, and countdown. The host brings {product} close to camera and demonstrates texture, function, audience, and offer. Start with product close-up, then host expression, price card, stock number, and claim button. Pace like a real livestream highlight: first-second benefit, middle detail and result, final clear link-up, flash sale, or coupon CTA. Use {photo} as first frame and product reference. On-screen text: "限时秒杀，先到先得", editable price area. Sound: original livestream beat, Mandarin host voice, countdown beeps, no real platform watermark or brand.
